title: Nylas notetaker.media notification object
description: Sent when a recording or transcription is processing, available, or deleted. When the [retention window](/docs/v3/notetaker/retention-policies/) elapses, Nylas sends a final `notetaker.media` notification with `status: media_deleted` and no `media` object. This schema describes `data.object` inside the Nylas notification envelope.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Notetaker bot.

grant_id.description: The grant ID that owns this Notetaker.

meeting_settings.description: Configuration for what the Notetaker captured.

summary.description: Whether AI summary generation was enabled.

custom_instructions.description: Prompt instructions for the AI summary.

action_items.description: Whether AI action item extraction was enabled.

action_items_settings.description: Custom instructions for action item extraction.

custom_instructions.description: Prompt instructions for action item extraction.

leave_after_silence_seconds.description: Seconds of silence before the bot automatically left the meeting.

messages.description: Custom announcements posted by the bot to the meeting chat. Present only when configured. See [Custom announcements](/docs/v3/notetaker/custom-announcements/).

on_join.description: Messages posted shortly after the bot joins, each on its own delay.

content.description: The message text (1–1,000 characters, HTML stripped).

send_after_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds from bot-join before posting (1–600,000).

on_participant_join.description: Messages posted on a trailing debounce when participants join.

content.description: The message text (1–1,000 characters, HTML stripped).

meeting_link.description: URL of the meeting the Notetaker attended.

join_time.description: Unix timestamp when the Notetaker joined.

event.description: Calendar event associated with this Notetaker.

ical_uid.description: iCalendar UID of the associated event.

event_id.description: Nylas event ID of the associated event.

master_event_id.description: Master event ID for recurring events.

state.description: Current state matching the media status.

media.description: Signed URLs for the media artifacts. Only present when `status` is `available`. Each sub-field is individually optional depending on the notetaker's `meeting_settings` — for example, `transcript` is only present if `transcription` was enabled, and `recording_file_format` is `mp3` instead of `mp4` for audio-only recordings.

recording.description: Signed URL to download the video/audio recording. Omitted when not available.

recording_duration.description: Duration of the recording in seconds. Omitted when not available.

recording_file_format.description: File format of the recording. `mp4` for video recordings, `mp3` for audio-only recordings. Omitted when not available.

thumbnail.description: Signed URL for the recording thumbnail image. Omitted when not available.

transcript.description: Signed URL to download the transcript. Omitted when not available.

summary.description: Signed URL to download the AI-generated summary. Omitted when not available.

action_items.description: Signed URL to download the AI-extracted action items. Omitted when not available.

retained_until.description: Unix timestamp when the media files will be automatically deleted per the notetaker's resolved `retention_time`. The clock starts when the media was first stored. Present whenever media is available; see [Notetaker retention policies](/docs/v3/notetaker/retention-policies/).

summary_settings.custom_instructions: Focus on action items related to the product launch.

action_items_settings.custom_instructions: Group action items by team member.

on_join.content: 👋 Hey team! I'm your AI notetaker — here to capture the key points.

on_participant_join.content: 👋 Welcome! Recording and transcription are running.
